description: This file defines the ScssHelper class which provides utility methods for manipulating SCSS color styles, such as darkening, lightening, converting to rgba, and validating colors. It uses the ScssPhp compiler to generate CSS from SCSS variables.

classes.name: ScssHelper
classes.description: A utility class for manipulating SCSS colors such as darkening, lightening, and converting to RGBA format, utilizing the ScssPhp compiler.

methods.name: getNewCompiler
methods.description: Initializes and returns a new SCSS compiler with output style set to compressed.

methods.name: darken
methods.description: Darkens a given color by a specified amount using SCSS functions.

methods.name: lighten
methods.description: Lightens a given color by a specified amount using SCSS functions.

methods.name: rgba
methods.description: Converts a color to RGBA format with a specified alpha transparency.

methods.name: isValidColor
methods.description: Validates whether a given string is a valid color by attempting to lighten it.
